name: Bosun — AI Coding Supervisor
description: Production-grade supervisor for autonomous AI coding agents. Routes tasks across executors, automates PR lifecycles, manages retries and failover, and keeps operators in control through notifications and dashboards. Inspired by the open-source Bosun framework.
author: AionUi
